comparison.objective: Trace tangled cables to match two box ends and place only the corresponding plugs into holders.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable identity tracing and plug placement without disturbing distractor cords versus sieve manipulation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct plugs in matching holders; moving distractor plugs, cross-placement, or pulling a cable from its box gives zero.
comparison.reason: Tests correspondence tracing through flexible cables.
